entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • IDE should respect "being in the comment context" and paste content with tripple/double slashes #79065
    Backlog
  • Title: BaseExpressionTypeClauseSyntax appears in official docs but is no longer part of Roslyn (4.13.0) #79055
  • Unexpected ref safety error in an assignment #79054
  • Razor generated files don't appear in Solution Explorer #79052
  • [Bug] Invalid IL sequence emitted for re-track from pointer to byref #79051
    Next
  • C# compiler crashes when C# references an enum based on `char` #79049

Closed

  • "Convert to top-level statements" does not correctly handle code excluded by conditional preprocessor directive #78002
    Backlog

Created

  • Stack Trace Explorer: Cancel previous navigation on new navigation #79069
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode

  • Allow Razor to configure source generator execution in tests #79050
    Area-IDE

    Area-IDE
  • Avoid acquiring the workspace lock on the UI thread if unneeded #79047
    Area-IDE
  • Sort usings #79044

    Next
